Synopsis:
After the goblin hunt celebration party (whether the player helped the goblins or the tieflings), Astarion has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night. For Astarion, this is a game of power - one he's played many times before in the taverns of Baldur's Gate, trying to lure people back to his master. He's an old hand at seduction, very self-assured at first, but the player might not go along with the script he expects them to follow. The next morning, the player wakes to see Astarion standing and getting dressed. They catch a glimpse of scars on his back - a sore point. The scars were carved into him by his old master. As far as Astarion knows, they're a poem, but he's never been able to read it (can't look in a mirror, after all).

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_SD_ROM_NightWithAstarion.json: The scene follows the goblin‑hunt celebration after the Emerald Grove was saved: Astarion arranged a private tryst with the player that night, treating it like the practiced game of seduction and power he learned in Baldur’s Gate taverns. He fronts as self‑assured and teasing, but his usual script falters if the player refuses to play along — the examples show his mask cracking into real vulnerability. The next morning the player wakes to see him dressing and notices deliberate scars on his back carved by his old master Cazador; Astarion calls them a “poem” written in Infernal but can’t read them himself. Off‑screen, grove figures and revelers (Halsin, Nettie, other celebrants) are nearby and Halsin has already detected the player’s tadpole, so prior choices about the den and goblin camp shape who’s present and the atmosphere.
- CAMP_AstarionHunger_SCO_Companion.json: You wake up and find Astarion hunching over you, fangs bared. You fight him off. Caught off guard, he's alarmed and worried that you're going to kill him. He tries to be charming, explaining that he's too weak without blood. If you push back against his excuses he gets frustrated - he tries to bargain with you. If you agree to let him bite you, he's thrilled. He feels in control again. After drinking, he feels invigorated and cocky.
- END_GameFinale_ROM_RomanceFates_Astarion.json: Astarion and the player he's in a romantic relationship with talk in a private bedroom in an inn, the morning after spending the night together after saving the world. A discussion of what comes next ensues, varying depending on how Astarion's story unfolded. He could:- Have killed Cazador and taken power to become the Vampire Ascendant.- Have killed Cazador and stayed a spawn (with reactivity to whether or not he killed the Spawn Prisoners.)- Not killed Cazador.
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.
- CAMP_Astarion_CRD_ScarReading.json: You find Astarion shirtless, tracing the scars on his back with his fingers, trying to read what they say through touch. Initially startled and a little embarrassed, he'll open up to anyone he thinks he can trust. An intimate moment, where he'll let characters with a high approval rating try to read what his scars say, or at least trace them into the dirt for him to read.

context: The scene follows the goblin‑hunt celebration (outcome may vary by whether you aided the goblins or the tieflings); that night Astarion arranged a private tryst, treating seduction as a practiced power game he honed in Baldur’s Gate taverns.
